Subject: VP/CTO intro — narrow calendar windows & mutual action plan (RetailOps)

Hi Alex and Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today — excellent conversation and helpful context on where RetailOps is headed on search-driven personalization. Quick recap + proposed next steps to keep momentum: 

- Discovery highlights: you have a pilot scope (product catalog + recommendations for the homepage and email), target latency SLO of <120ms tail for interactive recommendations, and a preference to evaluate both hosted and private deployment models because of data residency requirements.
- Red flags we noted: SSO + SCIM integration for your admin team, and a few SOC2 evidence asks from your security team.

Proposed next step: an executive alignment call (VP Engineering / CTO) to introduce Karthik (solutions) and Ben (AE) and to agree a short mutual action plan (MAP) so procurement and security can see a clear runway. Can you confirm which of the following 30-minute windows works for you?

- Tue, Nov 16 — 09:00–09:30 PT
- Wed, Nov 17 — 16:00–16:30 PT

If neither works, share two slots and we’ll adapt. Tentative attendee list from our side: Marissa Cole (you), Karthik Iyer (solutions), Ben Carter (account exec). From your side: VP Eng and CTO (or senior engineering leadership).

I attached a one-page MAP draft to give a sense of what we’ll try to align on in the call. If there are specific docs the security team wants ahead of time (SOC2 artifacts, data flow diagram, on-prem packaging notes), please flag them and I’ll coordinate delivery.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
